findings.resolution: Source 5c6b80e checks list/tab selection and collapsed ComboBox state. Final reviewer verified new evidence 2b1f325 and rejected corrupted selection/expansion variants; original finding retained in the actual accessibility/interoperability report.

findings.summary: Expanded evidence could omit the required visible descendant.
findings.resolution: Source 5c6b80e requires the expanded child, current parent, non-offscreen and visible rectangle. Final reviewer rejected absent/offscreen/wrong-parent/empty variants against the new capture and verified unchanged accepted semantic mappings.

findings.summary: Root, modal lifecycle and per-case identity bindings were insufficiently cross-checked.
findings.resolution: Source 5c6b80e binds roots to window references, enforces distinct modals and unchanged main identity outside replacement, and rejects restarted identity reuse. Independent final mapping/root/protocol checks passed on source-bound evidence 2b1f325.
